<script src="js/client.js"></script>
<script>
/* 团购渲染 ↓ */
(function () {
  var box = document.getElementById('dealSection');
  var list = document.getElementById('dealList');
  var empty = document.getElementById('dealEmpty');
  if (!box || !list || !window.ShiqianApi) return;
  function price(v) {
    var n = Number(v);
    return isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n.toFixed(n % 1 ? 2 : 0) : '';
  }
  function card(d) {
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'deal-card';
    var h = document.createElement('h4');
    h.textContent = d.title || d.name || '团购套餐';
    var meta = document.createElement('div');
    meta.className = 'deal-meta';
    var p = document.createElement('span');
    p.className = 'deal-price';
    var pv = price(d.price);
    p.textContent = pv ? '￥' + pv : '查看详情';
    var ov = price(d.originPrice);
    if (ov) {
      var s = document.createElement('s');
      s.textContent = '￥' + ov;
      p.appendChild(s);
    }
    meta.appendChild(p);
    var shop = d.shop || d.merchant || d.shopName || '';
    if (shop) {
      var sp = document.createElement('span');
      sp.textContent = shop;
      meta.appendChild(sp);
    }
    el.appendChild(h);
    el.appendChild(meta);
    return el;
  }
  /* 团购取数 ↓ */
  window.ShiqianApi.request('/v1/deals', { query: '附近 团购 套餐' }, 12000)
    .then(function (res) {
      var raw = (res && res.data && res.data.deals) || (res && res.deals) || [];
      var deals = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];
      list.textContent = '';
      if (!deals.length) { empty.hidden = false; box.hidden = false; return; }
      deals.slice(0, 6).forEach(function (d) { list.appendChild(card(d)); });
      box.hidden = false;
    })
    .catch(function () {
      /* 后端不可用时整块不出现，用户无感 */
    });
})();
</script>
<script src="js/mock.js"></script>
